interpretation: Positive IMPs favor the row model. Sample variance uses n−1. 95% Student-t intervals describe the mean of independent paired boards within one matchup. Repeated monitoring, multiple matchups, and selectable windows are exploratory; intervals are not adjusted for repeated looks or multiplicity. No legacy or cross-cohort pooling. Zero observed variance does not establish certainty. In-flight pairs are excluded; an incomplete prefix may favor faster boards. Earlier cohorts remain separate. Self-play has no strength IMP estimate. Own-bidder results include bidding/play interaction; common-v4 auctions isolate play. DD auction deltas for 3–2 update both partnerships and are descriptive.
